verdict.rationale: Docs confirm fraud/risk monitoring capabilities ("identify fraudulent behavior, stop suspicious payouts, and flag unusual user activities") and configurable monitoring rules/mitigations, plus ability to pause/control payouts and manage users. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated portfolio-wide dashboard view per sub-merchant, specific anomaly-alerting mechanics, or explicit offboarding tooling described in detail. Missing for 10: per-seller risk dashboard/scoring UI, alert configuration details, explicit offboarding workflow documentation, and independent/hands-on validation of these fraud tools in practice.
